email_draft.subject: Plainsboro's 600+ IEPs, less paperwork | Journify
email_draft.body:
Your superintendent's office requested pricing on April 19 for districts in Plainsboro's enrollment range, and I wanted to make sure the right context got back to you alongside those numbers.

At roughly 605 IEPs, your SPED team is large enough to feel real documentation strain but likely too lean on administrative support to absorb NJ's compliance timelines comfortably. Teachers on teams like yours report saving more than four hours per day when Journify handles IEP drafting, present-levels summaries, and progress notes, so your case managers and therapists spend their time running sessions and working with students, not catching up on paperwork after hours.

Worth 20 minutes this Thursday or Friday to walk through what pricing looks like for a district your size?
